record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: For a fixed Hilbert function, does there exist an ideal with greatest graded Betti numbers among all Gorenstein artinian graded ideals having that Hilbert function?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and $R = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the standard graded polynomial ring. A homogeneous ideal $I \subset R$ is called Gorenstein artinian if $R/I$ is an artinian Gorenstein $k$-algebra. The Hilbert function of $R/I$ is $h_{R/I}(t) = \dim_k (R/I)_t$, and the graded Betti numbers of $R/I$ are $\beta_{i,j}(R/I) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}^R_i(R/I,k)_j$.

Fix a function $h: \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \to \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ that arises as the Hilbert function of some Gorenstein artinian graded quotient of $R$. Consider the family $\mathcal{G}(h)$ of all Gorenstein artinian graded ideals $I \subset R$ with $h_{R/I} = h$.

Question: Does there exist an ideal $I^* \in \mathcal{G}(h)$ whose graded Betti numbers are simultaneously maximal in the family, i.e. such that $\beta_{i,j}(R/I^*) \geq \beta_{i,j}(R/I)$ for every $i, j$ and every $I \in \mathcal{G}(h)$?
artifact.category_tag: Gorenstein Betti numbers and Hilbert functions
artifact.status_search_result: Migliore and Nagel (2003) showed that for any SI-sequence, there is an arithmetically Gorenstein scheme whose artinian reduction has the weak Lefschetz property (WLP) and attains maximal graded Betti numbers among all such Gorenstein algebras with WLP and the given Hilbert function. Subsequent work (e.g., 2018 result on unique maximal Betti diagrams) extends this within the WLP class. The full question, without the WLP assumption and for arbitrary admissible Gorenstein Hilbert functions, does not appear to have been settled in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Reduced arithmetically Gorenstein schemes and simplicial polytopes with maximal Betti numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a reduced arithmetically Gorenstein configuration whose artinian reduction has the given SI-sequence as Hilbert function, WLP, and maximal graded Betti numbers among Gorenstein subschemes with WLP and that Hilbert function.
status_evidence.claim: Partial positive result under the WLP assumption for SI-sequences.

status_evidence.title: Unique maximal Betti diagrams for Artinian Gorenstein k-algebras with the weak Lefschetz property
status_evidence.snippet: Given an SI-sequence, the Betti diagrams of all Artinian Gorenstein algebras with WLP and that Hilbert function have a unique largest element.
status_evidence.claim: Maximal Betti diagram exists within the WLP subfamily.
